the swamp where Atreyu loses Artax

Spinach, cream cheese, sour cream, parmesan and garlic baked bubbling inside a hollowed cob loaf, with the torn bread toasted for dipping. Cut the top off a cob loaf and hollow it out, tearing the inside into chunks. Mix 250g thawed spinach squeezed dry, 250g cream cheese, 200g sour cream, 50g grated parmesan, a crushed garlic clove and pepper. Fill the loaf, replace the lid and wrap in foil. Bake at 190C for 25 minutes, adding the bread chunks to the tray for the last 10 minutes. Serve warm.
M: Chicken, pearl barley and vegetable soup with parsley and lemon
Chicken thighs simmered with barley, carrots, leek and celery for an hour, herbs and lemon stirred in at the end, served with brown bread.
the Childlike Empress in her Ivory Tower

Whole chicken rubbed with butter, lemon and tarragon and roasted golden, with silky white bean mash, buttered leeks and the pan juices. Mix 60g soft butter with chopped tarragon, lemon zest and salt and rub under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Warm 2 drained cans of cannellini beans with a garlic clove and 100ml stock, then blitz with 30g butter until smooth. Slice 2 leeks and cook gently in 30g butter for 10 minutes. Rest the chicken and spoon over the pan juices.

Egg whites whipped glossy with caster sugar, piped into big fluffy clouds, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, with cream and strawberries.

s.n: Ham and cheddar sandwiches, apple, nuts
s.note: Ham, cheddar and relish triangles, sliced red apples and a cone of mixed nuts
s.how: Butter white bread and fill with sliced ham, cheddar and a spoon of pickle relish. Cut into triangles. Slice 2 red apples and twist a handful of mixed nuts into a paper cone. Pack it all together like a lunch hidden away in a school attic.

s.note: Dark chocolate, marshmallow, almond and coconut chunks, chilled and smashed
s.how: Melt 300g dark chocolate. Stir in 150g marshmallows, 100g roasted almonds, 100g broken sweet biscuits and a handful of coconut. Press into a lined tray and chill for 2 hours. Smash into rough chunky rocks with the handle of a knife.

m.note: Chicken, pearl barley and vegetable soup with parsley and lemon
m.how: Simmer 600g chicken thighs with 100g pearl barley, 2 carrots, a leek and 2 celery sticks in 1.5L water for an hour. Shred the chicken back in, then stir through chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with brown bread.

w.note: Big crisp meringues with whipped cream and strawberries
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy. Spoon big fluffy clouds onto lined trays and bake at 100C for 90 minutes. Cool in the oven and serve with whipped cream and strawberries.

d.note: Chamomile and lemon peel tea with honey, hot or iced with apple juice
d.how: Brew 4 chamomile tea bags in 1L boiling water with a strip of lemon peel for 5 minutes. Stir in honey. Serve warm in small cups, or cool it and mix half and half with apple juice over ice. Calm enough for any oracle.
